items.name: Anna Keller
items.text: Our guide Karma knew every story behind every dzong. The Tiger's Nest hike was paced perfectly and the farmhouse dinner was a highlight.

items.name: Rahul Menon
items.text: Booking was simple and the team handled permits, hotels and transfers without a hitch. Punakha in spring was unforgettable.

items.name: Mei Tanaka
items.text: We went for the Paro Tshechu and had front-row spots for the masked dances. Thoughtful, calm and very well organised.

items.name: James Carter
items.text: The Druk Path trek was the best week of my year. Great camp crew, great food, and views of Jomolhari on day four.

items.name: Sofia Ruiz
items.text: Travelling with two kids we needed flexibility, and Bhutanova delivered — archery lessons, a hot stone bath and easy drives.

items.name: Daniel Osei
items.text: Clear pricing with the SDF explained upfront. No surprises, just a beautiful country and a team that genuinely cared.
